settings_data_storage_value: Public announcements are cached in cache.json; the last sync shows at launch, then syncs in the background (no database).
settings_avatar_cache_value: Public avatars and theme colors are cached in avatars.json; the cache is used at launch and conditional requests replace only changed images.
settings_menu_bar_value: Closing the window keeps the app in the menu bar and syncing; click the menu bar or Dock icon to reopen, and ⌘Q to quit.
settings_tray_value: Closing the window keeps the app in the system tray and syncing; click the tray icon to reopen, or quit from its menu.
settings_deadlines_value: System notification 3 days before a ticket deadline (asks for permission once; each deadline is announced only once).
settings_deadlines_unavailable: System notifications are unavailable for this run (not permitted, or not a packaged app).
settings_default_avatar_value: Without an avatar, or before one loads, one of three illustrations is drawn in the artist's theme color.
settings_demo_note: Fictional artists and announcements, for trying the merge rules offline
settings_avatars_value: Deezer public API (by artist name; QQ Music's photo when it cannot be reached or has no match, then iTunes cover art)
settings_theme_color_value: Uses the largest color area in the avatar (ignoring small white backgrounds and black shadows); set color in sources.yaml to override.
settings_pins_value: The pin at the right of the artist list moves an artist to the top; saved in the local pins.json, not account data.
settings_sidebar_value: {sidebar} expands / collapses to the icon rail; details panel {inspector}
settings_account_value: Coming in a later version (no sign-in needed now)
settings_principle_robots: Only public official or news information is read; robots.txt is followed per RFC 9309, with at least 1 second between requests to a site.
settings_principle_avatars: Avatars come from Deezer's public JSON API, not web pages; turn them off with avatars: off.
settings_principle_tba: Times and venues the announcement omits are not guessed but shown as TBA; uncertain details are marked for review.
settings_principle_changes: Postponements, cancellations and deadline changes are kept in a change log, never silently overwritten.
settings_principle_sources: Every item traces back to its source announcement, which can be opened to check.
sidebar_resizer_tooltip: Drag to resize the sidebar; press ←/→ when focused
inspector_resizer_tooltip: Drag to resize the details panel; press ←/→ when focused
notify_unavailable: System notifications are unavailable (a packaged app is required)
source_form_note: Writes to sources.yaml; add only public, permitted official or RSS sources
source_form_help: For a website, enter a LIVE / SCHEDULE / NEWS list page; for RSS, the feed URL. Do not add machine-translated pages or ones that need a sign-in.
source_form_after: Syncs once right after adding; disable or delete it on its card.
source_err_url: The URL must start with https:// (only public pages are read)
